summary: The root وثق (wthq) conveys securing oneself or something, often through a bond or firm action. It implies taking precautions, ensuring stability, or establishing trust.
lane: 10 اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنْهُ ذ [ He secured himself against him, by a bond or the like, or absolutely:] he took, or received, a bond ( وَثِيقَة ) from him. (S, K.) -b2- أُكْتُبُوهُ ٱسْتِيثَاقًا وَدَفْعًا لِلنِّزَاعِ [ Write ye it, (namely, the debt,) for the creditor's self-securing, and for preventing contention ]. (Jel, ii. 282.) See اِسْتَظْهَرَ . -b3- اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنَ البَابِ He closed the door firmly. (MA.) -b4- اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنْ أُمُورِهِ : see أَعْنَجَ . -b5- اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنَ المَالِ : see استوثج . -b6- اِسْتَوْثَقَ بِهِ He confided in him.

headwords.gloss: It was; became, firm, stable, fast; strong
headwords.def: وَثُقَ It was, or became, firm, stable, fast, or strong; (Msb;) i. q. أُحْكِمَ (S, Mgh, K) [or اِسْتَحْكَمَ , q. v.]. وَثِقَ بِهِ He trusted, or confided, in him. (S, Mgh, Msb, K.)

headwords.gloss: He made it firm, stable, fast; strong; He bound

parts.t: He made it firm, stable, fast,
in a bond. (S, K, TK.) See

headwords.def: أَوْثَقَهُ He made it firm, stable, fast, or strong. (Msb.) He bound, or tied, him, or it, firmly, fast, or strongly, in a bond. (S, K, TK.) See شَدَّهُ .
تَوَثَّقَتِ العُقْدَةُ [ The knot became firm, or fast ]. (A, in art. ارب .)

headwords.gloss: He secured himself against him; he took; received, a bond

parts.t: by a bond or the like, or absolutely:]

headwords.def: اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنْهُ [ He secured himself against him, by a bond or the like, or absolutely:] he took, or received, a bond ( وَثِيقَة ) from him. (S, K.) أُكْتُبُوهُ ٱسْتِيثَاقًا وَدَفْعًا لِلنِّزَاعِ [ Write ye it, (namely, the debt,) for the creditor's self-securing, and for preventing contention ]. (Jel, ii. 282.) See اِسْتَظْهَرَ . اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنَ البَابِ He closed the door firmly. (MA.) اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنْ أُمُورِهِ : see أَعْنَجَ . اِسْتَوْثَقَ مِنَ المَالِ : see استوثج . اِسْتَوْثَقَ بِهِ He confided in him.

headwords.gloss: Trusty; trustworthy; honest; In him is my trust; confidence

parts.t: applied as an epithet alike to a man and a woman, and to two or more men or women: pl.

headwords.def: ثِقَةٌ Trusty; trustworthy; honest: applied as an epithet alike to a man and a woman, and to two or more men or women: pl. ثِقَاتٌ . (Msb.) بِهِ ثِقَتِى In him is my trust, or confidence. (TA.) لَسْتُ مِنْهُ عَلَى ثِقَةٍ I am not confident, or sure, of it. Occurring in the S, art. ضمر , &c. See an ex. voce شَهْرٌ (last sentence). أَخُو ثِقَةٍ : see أَخٌ . أَخَذَ بِالثِّقَةِ : see أَخَذَ , and see my explanation of إِحْتَاطَ .

headwords.gloss: The doing the thing firmly; and taking the sure method; way; A bond, security

parts.t: The doing the thing firmly; and taking the sure method,
writing of obligation for the payment of a debt or the like:

headwords.def: الوَثِيقَةُ فِى الأَمْرِ The doing the thing firmly; and taking the sure method, or way; expl. by إِحْكَامُهُ والأَخْذُ بِالثَِّقَةِ . (TA.) وَثِيقَةٌ A bond, security, or writing of obligation for the payment of a debt or the like: pl. وَثَائِقُ . Ex., كِتْبَةُ الوَثَائِقِ (Bd, ii. 282,) The mode of writing bonds. A pledge. وَثِيقَةٌ i. q. دُرْجَةٌ , q. v.

headwords.gloss: He set about the affair in the surest; firmest, manner

parts.t: He set about the affair in the surest,

headwords.def: أَخَذَ الأَمْرَ بِالأَوْثَقِ He set about the affair in the surest, or firmest, manner. (TA.)

headwords.gloss: A compact; a contract; a covenant; an agreement; a league; a treaty; an engagement; a bond; an obligation; a promise

parts.t: A compact; a contract; a covenant; an agreement; a league; a treaty; an engagement; a bond; an obligation; a promise.

headwords.def: مَوْثِقٌ and A compact; a contract; a covenant; an agreement; a league; a treaty; an engagement; a bond; an obligation; a promise. (S, K, &c.)
مِيثَاقٌ : see مَوْثِقٌ ; and Jel, &c., in ii. 60 and 87.
مَوْثُوقٌ بِهِ In whom [and in which ] trust, or confidence, is placed. (Mgh.)

headwords.gloss: rendered firm, strong; compact, in make
headwords.def: مُوَثَّقَةُ الخَلْقِ A she-camel rendered firm, strong, or compact, in make. (S.)
